records.micronutrients: Sulphur 12.36-14.83 kg/ha (5-6 kg/acre, Gypsum 74.13-86.49 kg/ha); Zinc 2.47-3.71 kg/ha (1-1.5 kg/acre, Zinc Sulphate).
